title: Renew or restore a personal watercraft (PWC) driving licence
summary: Learn how to renew or restore your Personal Watercraft (PWC) driving licence.
intro: Personal watercraft (PWC) driving licences are renewable for 1, 3, 5 or 10 years. You'll need to take the PDF form in person to a Service NSW Centre or Mobile Service Centre.
who_can_apply: The PWC driving licence must be current, or not expired more than 5 years.
what_you_need: Your PWC driving licence details (if available)
The completed PDF form: Application for a Personal Watercraft Driving Licence

how_to_steps.text: Download and complete the Application for a Personal Watercraft Driving Licence – PDF.
Make sure you have the required documentation.
Visit a service centre/mobile service centre and submit your application.

more_info.text: The duration of a PWC driving licence can be one (1), 3, 5 or 10 years.
Licence fees vary depending on the duration of the licence, and whether they are concessional licences.
You must be under 16 years of age, or hold an eligible concession card at the time of payment, to receive a concession.

faqs.q: How long is a PWC driving licence valid for?
faqs.a: PWC driving licences can be renewed for 1, 3, 5, or 10 years.

faqs.q: Where do I submit my PWC licence application?
faqs.a: You must take the completed PDF form in person to a Service NSW Centre or Mobile Service Centre.

faqs.q: What is the eligibility requirement to renew my PWC licence?
faqs.a: Your PWC driving licence must be current, or not expired more than 5 years.
